            var odoo = { csrf_token: "", debug: "", __session_info__:  };
            // No apps to show: an empty menu tree, instead of fetching it.
            odoo.loadMenusPromise = Promise.resolve({
                root: { id: "root", name: "root", children: [], appID: false, xmlid: "", actionID: false },
            });
            // No server to stream notifications from: the bus worker is
            // replaced by one that only acknowledges its initialization.
            odoo.__session_info__.bus_info = { worker_version: "owlybook", last_id: 0 };
            (function () {
                class OfflineBusWorker extends EventTarget {
                    port = this;
                    start() {}
                    close() {}
                    postMessage(message) {
                        if (message?.action === "BASE:INIT") {
                            setTimeout(() => this.dispatchEvent(
                                new MessageEvent("message", { data: { type: "BASE:INITIALIZED" } })
                            ));
                        }
                    }
                }
                function isBusWorker(url) {
                    url = String(url);
                    if (url.startsWith("data:application/javascript;base64,")) {
                        url = atob(url.split(",")[1]);
                    }
                    return url.includes("/bus/websocket_worker_bundle");
                }
                for (const name of ["Worker", "SharedWorker"]) {
                    const NativeWorker = window[name];
                    if (NativeWorker) {
                        window[name] = function (url, options) {
                            return isBusWorker(url) ? new OfflineBusWorker() : new NativeWorker(url, options);
                        };
                    }
                }
            })();
            // In a sandboxed iframe the storages throw on access: keep the
            // values in memory instead, the story doesn't need them to last.
            for (const name of ["localStorage", "sessionStorage"]) {
                try {
                    window[name].setItem("__owlybook__", "1");
                    window[name].removeItem("__owlybook__");
                } catch {
                    const data = new Map();
                    const storage = {
                        getItem: (key) => (data.has(key) ? data.get(key) : null),
                        setItem: (key, value) => data.set(key, String(value)),
                        removeItem: (key) => data.delete(key),
                        clear: () => data.clear(),
                        key: (index) => [...data.keys()][index] ?? null,
                        get length() {
                            return data.size;
                        },
                    };
                    Object.defineProperty(window, name, { value: storage, configurable: true });
                }
            }
            // The web client fetches its translations at startup: answer from
            // the inlined copy instead of the network.
            (function () {
                const translations = document.getElementById("owlybook_translations").textContent;
                const fetch = window.fetch.bind(window);
                window.fetch = function (input, init) {
                    const url = typeof input === "string" ? input : input.url;
                    if (url.startsWith("/web/webclient/translations")) {
                        return Promise.resolve(new Response(translations, {
                            headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
                        }));
                    }
                    return fetch(input, init);
                };
            })();
        
        
        
        
        
            (async function () {
                async function inflate(id) {
                    const base64 = document.getElementById(id).textContent;
                    const bytes = Uint8Array.from(atob(base64), (char) => char.charCodeAt(0));
                    const stream = new Blob([bytes]).stream().pipeThrough(new DecompressionStream("gzip"));
                    return new Response(stream).text();
                }
                const [css, js] = await Promise.all([inflate("owlybook_css"), inflate("owlybook_js")]);
                const style = document.createElement("style");
                style.textContent = css;
                document.head.appendChild(style);
                const script = document.createElement("script");
                script.textContent = js;
                document.head.appendChild(script);
            })();
